name: Adah
overview: The name Adah appears in Scripture as the wife of two significant biblical figures: Lamech and Esau. As Lamech's wife, Adah is noted for bearing Jabal, the ancestor of those who dwell in tents and raise livestock, highlighting her role in the early development of human civilization (Genesis 4:19-20). Additionally, Adah is identified as the mother of Eliphaz, one of Esau's sons, linking her to the lineage of Edom (Genesis 36:10). These references emphasize Adah's place within God's providential plan through her contributions to important genealogical lines.
